SERVICE_HEADLINE: German cars, repaired the way they were built
TAGLINE: Collision, paint and mechanical work on German luxury vehicles, using the engineering techniques the marque expects. Verified with the major insurers.
ADDRESS: 5332 Topanga Canyon Blvd, Woodland Hills, CA 91364
SERVICES_INTRO: A body shop that also understands what is underneath the panel, which matters more on a German car than most.
SERVICE_1_BODY: Structural and panel work to the standard the marque specifies, not the standard that merely looks right.
SERVICE_2_BODY: Colour matched properly, because a slightly wrong panel is visible forever.
SERVICE_3_BODY: The mechanical side handled in house, so a collision repair does not become two separate bills.
WHY_INTRO: There are other shops within a few minutes of here. This is what a customer actually notices.
WHY_1_BODY: The quote comes before the work, and nothing gets done without you agreeing to it.
WHY_2_BODY: A person picks up during opening hours, and a missed call gets returned the same day.
WHY_3_BODY: Whatever came off the car is there to look at if you want to see it.
CONTACT_INTRO: Call for anything urgent. For a quote or a booking the form reaches the desk directly.
ABOUT_BODY: GermanTek has been repairing German luxury vehicles in Woodland Hills since 2005, using the engineering techniques the marques expect. Some of the technicians bring over forty years of auto body and mechanical experience, and the shop is verified with the major insurers.
